name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.29.0 (minor, auto-merge-completion observability lib re-ship): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.28.0 -> 0.29.0 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so it carries verify-integrate 0.11.0 + scheduling 0.43.0's sources — lib/verify_integrate.py (RECONCILE now records every merged acted_ledger PR in reconcile_result.auto_merged, surfacing an auto-merge GitHub completed asynchronously between ticks) and lib/run_tick.py (tick_end surfaces auto_merged + auto_merged_refs; _persist_reconcile_outcome stamps those ledger entries terminal outcome="merged" so the completion reports exactly once). The shipped default-config CONTENT is unchanged (still schema 2.9.0, same values); this release only re-normalizes the affected libs from the merged sources and stamps plugin.json + marketplace.json to 0.29.0. The version-assertion test advanced to 0.29.0, test/release_lib_baseline.json re-anchored (version -> 0.29.0, lib_digest -> the new committed-lib digest since the shipped lib bytes changed) so the drift and #355 monotonicity guards stay green.
spec_no_change_reason: Spec surface already advanced to the v0.29.0 release note in commit 5696c97 at cycle start; release-cut cycle carries no further spec change beyond the _PLUGIN_VERSION bump.
